## Vue d'ensemble

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Encadrements par année et par type"
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

try:
    df = pd.read_csv("data/encadrements.csv")
    agg = df.groupby(["annee", "type"]).size().reset_index(name="count")
    fig = px.bar(
        agg, x="annee", y="count", color="type",
        labels={"count": "Nombre d'encadrements", "annee": "Année"},
        color_discrete_sequence=["#C8102E", "#4A4A4A", "#0277BD", "#2E7D32"],
    )
    fig.update_layout(template="plotly_white", height=400, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
    fig.show()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Données encadrements à compléter ({e})")
```

## Liste des encadrements

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True)

try:
    df = pd.read_csv("data/encadrements.csv")
    show(df, lengthMenu=[10, 25, 50], classes="display compact")
except Exception:
    print("À compléter — voir data/encadrements.csv")
```
